name: @phlix/contracts
description: Framework-agnostic TypeScript REST/wire DTO types + tiny pure helpers for Phlix — the single source of truth for media, playback, auth, hub, library, and event shapes, the estate error-code registry, the server route manifest, and MCP scopes, shared across every Phlix client and both servers. Mirrors detain/phlix-shared and the server's JSON response shapes. No Vue/React/axios.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/emit-mcp-scopes.mjs && node scripts/emit-server-route-manifest.mjs && node scripts/emit-error-codes.mjs

author: detain
